# Notifications (community, Node only)

Posts to a Slack incoming webhook when a comment waits for review (`comments.after.create`) or a scheduled job fails (`schedule.after.run`). Both hooks are detached, so Slack never slows a save, and a Slack outage only writes a warning to the log.

comments is only suggested: without it, the comment hook never fires. The webhook URL is a secret setting, and only `https://hooks.slack.com/services/...` is accepted, matching `egress`.

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| hook | `config.before.save` | configuration is about to be written (dashboard, `hax plugin config set`, install migration) | Refuses a webhook setting that is not a https://hooks.slack.com/services/ URL. |
| hook | `comments.after.create` | a hook another plugin defines | Posts to Slack when a new comment is waiting for review, if onPending is on. |
| hook | `schedule.after.run` | the scheduled job finished (detached) | Posts to Slack when a scheduled job of any plugin fails, if onJobFailure is on. |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs`.
